base_python_rule: A venv must be built on a NORMAL system interpreter. Never on a temp/cache/tool-runtime path -- one built under ~\.cache\ was destroyed by ordinary system cleanup and took 2.64 GB of working packages with it (AGENTS.md section 2, rule 2).

machine_tools.resolution_rule: Do not hardcode these paths anywhere. Run scripts/check_video_environment.ps1, or read them from scripts/resolve_ffmpeg.ps1 (function Resolve-FfmpegPair when dot-sourced, `-Emit` for shell consumers). The WinGet install these paths previously pointed at has been uninstalled.
